system.description: Duration: Permanent Effect: Creates 500 square feet of iron This spell creates a wall of iron 2" thick (or less) with an area equal to 500 square feet; it may be arranged in any fashion the caster desires (10'x 50' wall, or 25' X 20' wall, etc.) Casting time varies depending on the complexity of the design. A simple wall and other simple shapes take 1 round. A simple staircase may take 10 rounds (1 turn). A complicated design which is supposed to adhere to very tight specifications—such as a giant portcullis—could take the maximum time allowable, 12 turns (2 hours) just to create in rough form.
